title: KCP invocation_create request (DESIGN.md §10.6, §11.6.1 direct invocation, §15.1)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Creates an Invocation by authenticated direct command or explicit deployment test (§15.1); the server builds and digests the InvocationInputManifest before scheduling (gap note KG5). Registry (developer_assistant_v1): surface external_client / authenticated principal; authenticated operator (assurance: current login; production test may require step-up). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

context_assembly_ref.description: Immutable ContextAssembly for the input manifest (§15.1); pairing with context_assembly_digest is a registry rule.

args.description: The §11.6.1 direct-invocation row's caller inputs mapped onto §10.6 field names (gap note KG13): full target deployment/revision, ContextAssembly, budget, disclosure; deadline and max_attempts are committed before the first attempt (§15.4). No requester or commitment member exists: a direct invocation cannot name a worker as requester or create a Commitment (§11.6.1).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
